title: City Park sample screen (screen 6, the old oak)
note: Your picks of 26 Oct: the trees Pepper climbs at true width with one leaf mass whose top is above the world (decision 1), and young 6 m mid trees (decision 2b). Screen 6 at both cameras: up on the high road she runs through the old oak's leaves; down on the path the oak stands at full size with its branches as her ledges. New: the old oak (trunk 54 px), a park lime at x 1528 (screens 5 and 6), three young mid trees (a lime, a maple, a birch, 139 px). The ash at x 1916 keeps its old trunk until it is made. Review round 1 fixed: no ink edges on the trees (the bark's own darker brown), highlights brought down so the trees are never lighter than the tree line behind them, the oak's loose limb pieces and flat crown cut, the maple's specks, the birch trunk no longer a bright pole, old small crowns no longer poke through the new ones. Nothing she stands on moved. Checks: PEPPER UNCHANGED, flow 125/125, Tiled, physics 97/97, QA 0 problems, curve T1-T4 PASS. Layers light to dark: sky 202, far city 191, tree line 181, mid 154-159, back 118-138, play 80-91. SpriteCook 132 credits.
question: Two scale calls for you. Oak: its trunk is 54 px (1.2 m); the plan said 46 px for the old oak and 60 px for the big oak on screen 9. Keep 54, or ask for a slimmer old oak? Lime: scale over spec, your call: trunk 36 px (spec 23), crown 468 px (spec 250). A recolour of the approved River Walk lime (23 px trunk) was not made: it is 251 px tall, so in this 384 px tall level its top would end at y 68 and show with sky above it on the high road, against your taller-than-the-screen rule. Keep this lime, or a slimmer lime made taller than the screen?

members.title: old oak
members.note: Replaces the small old oak in the tall level only. Trunk 54 px, roots flared; crown 388 px, its top above the world. No outline: the bark's edge is its own darker brown, the leaves' edge their dark rust. 8 colours. Faded 28 % like the gate so its darkest bark sits at the back layer's 80.
